de.title: Mezzanine-Finanzierung: Eigenkapital ergänzen | HYPOTEQ
de.description: Fehlt Eigenkapital für Kauf oder Projekt? Mit Mezzanine-Kapital schliesst du die Lücke zwischen Hypothek und Eigenmitteln. Unverbindlich anfragen.

sections.lead: Mit einer **Mezzanine-Finanzierung für Immobilien** schliesst du die Lücke zwischen Bankhypothek und Eigenkapital, ohne Anteile abzugeben. Für Developer, Family Offices und Bestandshalter, die ein Projekt jetzt umsetzen wollen.

sections.title:
Kapital in der Mitte.
*Wirkung für das ganze Projekt.*
paragraphs: Mezzanine-Kapital ist **nachrangiges Kapital** zwischen Eigenkapital und Bankfinanzierung. Die Bank finanziert die erste Tranche mit Grundpfand, das **Nachrangdarlehen** füllt den Teil darüber, den die Bank nicht übernimmt.
So musst du weder auf das Projekt warten noch Mitinvestoren an Bord holen, die Anteile und Mitsprache verlangen. Die Eigentümerstruktur bleibt, wie sie ist.
bullets: Ergänzt die Hypothek, ersetzt sie nicht
Keine Verwässerung deiner Beteiligung
Passend für Neubau, Akquisition und Zwischenfinanzierung

sections.title:
Developer, Family Offices,
*Bestandshalter.*
paragraphs: Mezzanine richtet sich an **professionelle Immobilienakteure**: Developer mit mehreren Projekten, Family Offices mit Immobilienstrategie und Bestandshalter, die ihr Portfolio weiterentwickeln.

Für den klassischen Eigenheimkauf ist Mezzanine selten die richtige Lösung. Fehlt dir dort Eigenkapital, prüfen wir zuerst Vorsorgegelder, Belehnung und Tragbarkeit. Bei komplexen Fällen hilft unser **Advisory**.

items.title: Partnerprogramm
items.text: Makler, Treuhänder und Vermögensverwalter bringen Projekte ein. Die Kundenbeziehung bleibt beim Partner.

items.a: Ein **nachrangiges Darlehen** zwischen Eigenkapital und Bankhypothek. Es schliesst eine Finanzierungslücke, ohne dass du Anteile an deinem Projekt abgibst.
Für Developer, Family Offices und Bestandshalter bei Neubau, Akquisition, Zwischenfinanzierung oder einer Eigenmittellücke. Für private Eigenheime ist es nur selten sinnvoll.

items.q: Was kostet Mezzanine im Vergleich zur Hypothek?
items.a: Mezzanine ist **teurer als eine Hypothek**, weil der Kapitalgeber im Nachrang steht und mehr Risiko trägt. Die konkreten Konditionen hängen vom Projekt ab und werden individuell offeriert.

items.q: Kann ich damit fehlendes Eigenkapital ersetzen?
items.a: Teilweise. Mezzanine ergänzt Eigenkapital, ersetzt es aber nicht vollständig. Banken und Kapitalgeber erwarten weiterhin einen substanziellen eigenen Beitrag.

fr.title: Financement mezzanine immobilier | HYPOTEQ
fr.description: Il vous manque des fonds propres? Le capital mezzanine comble l'écart entre hypothèque et fonds propres pour un achat ou un projet. Demande gratuite.

sections.lead: Le **financement mezzanine immobilier** comble l'écart entre l'hypothèque bancaire et vos fonds propres, sans céder de parts. Pour les développeurs, family offices et détenteurs de portefeuilles qui veulent réaliser leur projet maintenant.

sections.title:
Un capital intermédiaire.
*Un effet sur tout le projet.*
paragraphs: Le capital mezzanine est un **capital subordonné** situé entre les fonds propres et le financement bancaire. La banque finance la première tranche, garantie par gage immobilier, et le **prêt subordonné immobilier** couvre la part qu'elle ne prend pas.
Vous n'avez ni à reporter le projet ni à faire entrer des co-investisseurs qui exigent des parts et un droit de regard. La structure de propriété reste inchangée.
bullets: Complète l'hypothèque, sans la remplacer
Aucune dilution de votre participation
Adapté aux constructions, acquisitions et financements relais

items.title: Achat d'immeubles

items.title: Financement intermédiaire

sections.title:
Développeurs, family offices,
*détenteurs de portefeuilles.*
paragraphs: Le mezzanine s'adresse aux **acteurs immobiliers professionnels**: développeurs gérant plusieurs projets, family offices dotés d'une stratégie immobilière et détenteurs qui font évoluer leur portefeuille.

Pour l'achat d'une résidence principale, ce n'est que rarement la bonne solution. S'il vous manque des fonds propres, nous examinons d'abord le 2e pilier, le taux d'avance et la capacité financière. Pour les cas complexes, notre **conseil hypothécaire** vous accompagne.

items.a: Un **prêt subordonné** situé entre les fonds propres et l'hypothèque bancaire. Il comble un manque de financement sans que vous cédiez de parts de votre projet.

Aux développeurs, family offices et détenteurs de portefeuilles, pour une construction, une acquisition, un financement relais ou un manque de fonds propres. Pour une résidence principale, il est rarement adapté.

items.q: Combien coûte le mezzanine par rapport à l'hypothèque?
items.a: Le mezzanine est **plus cher qu'une hypothèque**, car le bailleur de fonds est subordonné et porte davantage de risque. Les conditions concrètes dépendent du projet et font l'objet d'une offre individuelle.
En partie. Le mezzanine complète les fonds propres sans les remplacer entièrement. Banques et bailleurs attendent toujours un apport personnel substantiel.

it.description: Mancano fondi propri? Il capitale mezzanine colma il divario tra ipoteca e mezzi propri per acquisti o progetti. Richiesta senza impegno.

sections.lead: Con un **finanziamento mezzanine immobiliare** colmi il divario tra ipoteca bancaria e fondi propri, senza cedere quote. Per developer, family office e detentori di portafogli che vogliono realizzare subito il loro progetto.

sections.title:
Capitale nel mezzo.
*Effetto su tutto il progetto.*
paragraphs: Il capitale mezzanine è **capitale subordinato** tra fondi propri e finanziamento bancario. La banca copre la prima tranche con garanzia ipotecaria, il **prestito subordinato immobile** copre la parte che la banca non assume.
Così non devi rinviare il progetto né coinvolgere coinvestitori che chiedono quote e voce in capitolo. La struttura di proprietà resta invariata.
bullets: Completa l'ipoteca, non la sostituisce

Adatto a nuove costruzioni, acquisizioni e finanziamenti ponte

Per l'acquisto della casa in cui abiti è raramente la soluzione giusta. Se ti mancano fondi propri, verifichiamo prima cassa pensione, anticipo e sostenibilità. Per i casi complessi c'è la nostra **consulenza ipotecaria**.

items.a: Un **prestito subordinato** tra fondi propri e ipoteca bancaria. Colma una lacuna di finanziamento senza che tu debba cedere quote del progetto.
A developer, family office e detentori di portafogli, per nuove costruzioni, acquisizioni, finanziamenti ponte o mancanza di fondi propri. Per la casa propria è adatto solo di rado.
Il mezzanine è **più caro di un'ipoteca**, perché il finanziatore è subordinato e si assume più rischio. Le condizioni concrete dipendono dal progetto e vengono offerte singolarmente.
In parte. Il mezzanine completa i fondi propri ma non li sostituisce del tutto. Banche e finanziatori si aspettano comunque un contributo proprio sostanziale.

en.title: Mezzanine Financing for Swiss Real Estate | HYPOTEQ
en.description: Short on equity? Mezzanine capital bridges the gap between your mortgage and own funds for purchases or projects in Switzerland. Enquire today.

sections.lead: **Mezzanine financing for real estate in Switzerland** bridges the gap between your bank mortgage and your equity, without giving away shares. For developers, family offices and portfolio holders who want to move a project forward now.
sections.alt: Residential neighbourhood in Zurich with apartment buildings

items.label: typical term of the subordinated loan

sections.title:
Capital in the middle.
*Impact on the whole project.*
paragraphs: Mezzanine capital is **subordinated capital** that sits between equity and bank financing. The bank funds the first tranche, secured by a mortgage on the property, and a **subordinated real estate loan** covers the part above it that the bank will not take.
You neither have to put the project on hold nor bring in co-investors who want shares and a say. Your ownership structure stays exactly as it is.
bullets: Complements the mortgage, does not replace it
No dilution of your stake
Suits new builds, acquisitions and bridge financing
sections.alt: Documents and laptop on a desk

items.title: Development projects
items.text: When the bank only funds part of the construction costs and your equity is tied up in other projects.

items.title: Buying properties
items.text: When an opportunity comes up before proceeds from a sale are available.

items.title: Gap financing
items.text: To bridge a phase, for example until letting, sale or refinancing.

items.title: Not enough equity
items.text: When the bank requires more own funds than are currently available in the project.

sections.title:
What a subordinated loan
*can look like.*
head: Bank mortgage
Mezzanine capital
sections.note: Terms depend on the project, the risk and the capital provider. We assess every case individually; there are no standard prices.

sections.title:
Developers, family offices,
*portfolio holders.*
paragraphs: Mezzanine is aimed at **professional real estate players**: developers running several projects, family offices with a property strategy and holders who are growing their portfolio.

For buying your own home it is rarely the right fit. If you are short on a down payment, we first look at pension assets (pillar 2 and 3a), loan-to-value and affordability. For complex cases, our **advisory** team can help.
bullets: Clear documents on project, costs and timeline
Bank financing as the foundation
Realistic exit: sale, letting or refinancing

items.text: We review documents, bank financing and exit scenario and show where the gap lies.

items.title: Structuring
items.text: Fixed or variable, bullet or amortising, with or without profit participation.

items.title: Execution
items.text: We coordinate the senior financing and the subordinated capital through to drawdown.

items.title: Buy-to-let financing
items.text: Apartment buildings and investment flats: equity and amortisation requirements.

items.title: Construction financing
items.text: Construction loans, stages and conversion into a mortgage.

items.title: Partner programme
items.text: Brokers, fiduciaries and wealth managers bring us projects. The client relationship stays with them.

items.a: A **subordinated loan** that sits between equity and the bank mortgage. It closes a financing gap without you giving away shares in your project.
Developers, family offices and portfolio holders, for new builds, acquisitions, bridge financing or an equity gap. For a private home it is rarely the right solution.

items.q: How much does it cost compared to a mortgage?
items.a: Mezzanine is **more expensive than a mortgage**, because the capital provider ranks behind the bank and carries more risk. Actual terms depend on the project and are quoted individually.
Partly. Mezzanine complements equity but does not fully replace it. Banks and capital providers still expect a substantial contribution of your own.
